**Area:** [UIKit](../COVERAGE.md#uikit) · **Apple:** [UIKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit) · **Issues:** [`area:uikit`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Auikit)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** isim's own Objective-C UIKit (`isim/frameworks/UIKit/`) with Swift overlays (`isim/swift/overlays/UIKit*.swift`).
- Drawing is software rendering with cairo and Pango into an SDL3 window (`isim/runtime/host*.c`); there is no GPU.
- Core Animation (`CoreAnimation.m`), Auto Layout (a Cassowary solver, `Cassowary.c`) and TextKit 1/2 on Pango (`UITextKitEngine.m`) are isim's own.
- Fonts are Adwaita stand-ins for SF; SF Symbols are procedural stand-ins (`isim/runtime/host_symbols.inc`).
- The system UI is simulated: keyboards, alerts, sheets, VoiceOver (spoken with espeak-ng), Switch Control and Voice Control.
- The host keyboard and mouse supply touches, keys and the pointer.
- Objective-C: the headers are in `isim/sdk-src/Frameworks/UIKit`; some iOS 14+ APIs exist only in Swift (see the Objective-C interfaces table in COVERAGE.md).

Stub for suggestions themselves: isim has no Apple Intelligence, so the keyboard suggests no replies. Tested (HelloTextFormatting, OS matrix) |
| Focus system (`UIFocusSystem`, focus environments, guides, effects, debugger) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted (iPad keyboard navigation): each iPad window has a `UIFocusSystem`. `focusSystem(for:)` is nil on iPhone, as on iOS; also `focusedItem`, `requestFocusUpdate(to:)`, `updateFocusIfNeeded()`, `environment(_:contains:)`. Focus items are views whose `canBecomeFocused` is true: custom views, text fields, and the cells of lists with `allowsFocus` or the delegate's `canFocusItemAt` / `canFocusRowAt`. Items group by `focusGroupIdentifier`, else by their list, else each item alone. Tab and Shift-Tab move between groups, landing on the remembered item unless a higher `focusGroupPriority` item wins. The arrows move within a group. Return or Space presses the item: a cell is selected, a control sends its primary action, and any other view gets the presses (the focused view is first in the chain). A focused text field becomes the first responder, and Tab moves on from it. `UIFocusEnvironment` on views and view controllers: `preferredFocusEnvironments`, `parentFocusEnvironment`, `focusItemContainer`, `setNeedsFocusUpdate()`, `shouldUpdateFocus(in:)`, `didUpdateFocus(in:with:)`. `UIFocusUpdateContext`, including the table and collection view contexts with index paths, their delegates' focus methods and `selectionFollowsFocus`. Also `UIFocusHeading`, `UIFocusAnimationCoordinator` and `UIFocusAnimationContext`, `didUpdateNotification` / `movementDidFailNotification` and their iOS 26 messages, and `UIFocusGuide` (redirects arrow movement). `UIFocusHaloEffect` (rect, rounded rect or path; inside or outside) draws a ring in the tint colour; a plain `UIFocusEffect` draws none. `UIFocusItemDeferralMode`: programmatic focus waits for keyboard input unless the item's mode is `.never`, and a touch hides the halo until the next key. `UIFocusItemContainer` / `UIFocusItemScrollableContainer` (`focusItems(in:)`, `visibleSize`). `UIFocusDebugger` returns text reports. Stubs: `UIFocusMovementHint` and `didHintFocusMovement(_:)` (tvOS remote touches, never sent on iPad), `UIFocusSoundIdentifier` (tvOS sounds). Tested (HelloMenusFocus, iPad, OS matrix) |

Engine, events, parameters, parameter curves, patterns (incl. AHAP dictionaries/files, `exportDictionary`), players and advanced players (pause/resume/seek/loop/rate, completion handlers, `notifyWhenPlayersFinished`) are modelled and timed; playback is logged on stderr, never felt or heard. Tested (HelloCoreAnimation) |
